name: Button Group
description: Buttons joined into one connected row or column, optionally working as a toggle group.

props.name: orientation
props.description: A row, or a column of equal-width buttons.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of every button in the group, unless one sets its own.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Turns the group into a toggle group of ButtonGroupItem children. Leave it out for ordinary Buttons.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the new set of selected ids.

props.name: disallowEmptySelection
props.description: Keep at least one item selected.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables every button in the group.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the group. Without a selection mode it also accepts every prop of a div; give it an aria-label.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. Leave it out for an icon-only square.

props.name: iconStart
props.description: Icon before the label, sized to 16 pixels. Give an icon-only item an aria-label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components ToggleButton.
